name: SimpleQA
description: Factuality benchmark with 4,326 short fact-seeking questions measuring parametric knowledge and resistance to hallucination. Designed to challenge frontier models where older QA benchmarks saturated.
creator: OpenAI

dataset.source: Diverse fact-seeking questions verified by two independent annotators

notes: Frontier models score 35-50%. GPT-4o <40%. Tests calibration - whether models know what they know. SimpleQA Verified (1000 prompts) released 2025.
